evaluated_options.reason: Safe only when no numeric P-lane is reused across semantic namespaces.
Solves collisions but weakens existing global continuity surfaces unless paired with canonical IDs.
Composite IDs remove ambiguity but require a migration surface before becoming canonical.
Preserves current global lane history while requiring composite namespace aliases for branch-local P-number reuse.

namespace_policy_recommendation.required_future_rule: Use composite namespace aliases for branch-local references that reuse a numeric P-lane already observed in another semantic namespace.
